lineage: S108 produced positive stress and severe PnL, positive long and short attribution, positive primary and portability clusters, six-of-six positive leave-one-out PnL and positive bootstrap p10, but failed only the predeclared sample-count checks with eight fills. S109 preserves S108 flow, funding, direction, execution, stop, target and risk rules while replacing its single rolling extreme with named professional liquidity anchors.
selection_disclosure: S109 was designed after S108 results and diagnostics were inspected. Historical success may reject or start paper observation only; it cannot validate live profitability.

unchanged_from_s108.direction: S101 daily global regime plus completed 4h EMA50 trend; UP long, DOWN short, SIDEWAYS flat.
unchanged_from_s108.sweep_attention: 15m sweep with 60m OI expansion >=0.05%, relative volume >=1.10, metrics age <=15m, aggressive taker flow and seven-day funding filter.
unchanged_from_s108.confirmation: Later break of the sweep candle in the reversal direction with both candle and archive taker-flow flip; fill next 5m open.
unchanged_from_s108.stop: Beyond sweep plus 0.20 ATR, widened only to 1.25 ATR minimum, rejected above 3.50 ATR; initial stop never moves.
unchanged_from_s108.target: 90% toward opposite rolling 96-bar liquidity, minimum 1.80R, maximum 3.00R.
unchanged_from_s108.risk: One global position; 0.2% NAV capped at $0.50 then multiplied by 0.50; leverage <=5, notional <=75%, margin <=15%; maximum hold 24h.

session_liquidity_atlas.repeated_touch_bonus: One point per prior touch beyond the first within 0.25 ATR, capped at two, measured over 96 closed 15m candles.
session_liquidity_atlas.confirmation_window: Six later closed 15m candles (90 minutes), replacing S108's three-bar window.

predeclared_historical_gate.combined: At least 18 stress fills; stress PnL >$1.5964011161, PF >1.15, DD <=5%; severe PnL >$1.1424016449.
predeclared_historical_gate.direction: At least five stress longs and five stress shorts; both direction PnLs non-negative.
predeclared_historical_gate.breadth: At least three represented symbols and at least four of six leave-one-symbol-out stress PnLs positive.
predeclared_historical_gate.clusters: Primary and portability groups each have at least six stress fills and non-negative stress and severe PnL.
predeclared_historical_gate.time: At least three of four stress slices positive, no slice below -$1.00 and at least 35% positive calendar months.
predeclared_historical_gate.uncertainty: Circular 28-day block-bootstrap p10 terminal PnL positive.
predeclared_historical_gate.decision: Every check must pass to start paper-forward observation. Live remains disabled.

claim_policy: No backtest guarantees profit. No S109 rule may change after this file is hashed and before replay completion.
